title: Fix load-flaky parallelism timing assertions in susi-gawd-swarm
goal: parallel_roadmap_e2e_tests::parallel_roadmap_e2e_three_models_overlap_and_close (crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/tests/parallel_roadmap_e2e.rs:668) and roadmap_agents::tests::parallel_roadmap_agents_execute_in_parallel_on_distinct_models (roadmap_agents.rs:621) assert wall-clock budgets of 300ms/150ms for a 3-way thread rendezvous plus real git worktree setup. On a contended multi-agent host (load avg >70) both flake: measured 338-344ms and 164ms. Budgets are hardcoded with no retry; replace with a rendezvous-only assertion (e.g. prove all 3 overlapped via the Rendezvous counter) or scale the budget by measured serial baseline.
